senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to melt,] cmp. דאב a. יצף, to be low-spirited, to sorrow, fear.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 106b">Snh. 106ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>דאג</he>, <cite ref="I Samuel 21:8">I Sam. XXI, 8</cite>, a. <he>דוֹיֹג</he>, <cite ref="I Samuel 22:18">ib. XXII, 18</cite>) at first <he>יושב הקב״ה ודוֹאֵג וכ׳</he> the Lord sat in anxiety, that he (Doeg) might degenerate; after …, He said <he>ו̇וי̇ שיצא זה</he> woe that he did &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 40a:4">Ber. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>יִדְאַג מריח וכ׳</he> must be in fear of contracting &c.
<cite ref="Chagigah 13a:5">Ḥag. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>שלבו דואג בקרבו</he> whose heart within him is in fear of sin (reverential).
<cite ref="Shabbat 105b">Sabb. 105ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>יִדְאֲגוּ כל האחין</he> all the brothers should feel troubled (examine their ways).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 48:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XLVIII</cite> a man committed a sin <he>והיה דואג בלבו</he> and was troubled in his heart; a. fr.
